newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major says EMU failure would mean catastrophe.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major says EMU failure would mean catastrophe.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major said on Wednesday that failure of the planned single European currency would mean economic catastrophe across the whole of Europe.
"Suppose we went in (the single currency) and it didn't work," Major told an election campaign news conference.

"The economic catastrophe across the whole of Europe, or what principally concerns me, here in the United Kingdom, would be beyond calculation if we entered a single currency and that single currency then failed," he said.

Major said the effects of a single currency on Britain were still unknown. But he said that inward investment into Britain could be harmed if Britain stayed out of the single currency. -- London Newsroom +44-171-542-7947
